JOIN leisurefeature lf ON lf.id = fr.leisurefeature_id
WHERE c.name = 'New York'
  AND lf.feature = 'Swimming Pool'

FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "hotels" h ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
335:
SELECT COUNT(h."fees") AS fees_count
FROM "house" h
JOIN "propertytype" pt ON h."property_type_id" = pt."id"
WHERE pt."type" LIKE '%Condo%'
  AND h."fees" IS NOT NULL;
339:
SELECT
    h."fees",
    h."taxes"
FROM "house" h
JOIN "propertytype" pt ON pt."id" = h."property_type_id"
WHERE pt."type" LIKE '%Condo%';
340:
SELECT h."taxes"
FROM "house" h
ORDER BY h."house_price" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
